thread:
deploy-bot: kicking off staggered publish for redwood-sdk (py + ts). cohorts: 1..5. default cadence 10m. opt-in/opt-out window: 20m. artifacts: wheel, sdist, npm package. tagging policy: npm -> next-canary, py -> canary.

maya.dev: quick note: CI smoke found missing named export in the TS bundle on canary build 2. stack traces from internal app show `cannot find export 'createClient'` when importing from '@redwood/sdk'. rick_sdk: that sounds like our rollup config dropped named exports due to `preserveModules` flip. I saw a change in the TS package's build script earlier today. ops_sam: what's the blast radius? are any customers on cohort 2 already? deploy-bot: cohort 2 live on 50% internal alpha, 10% external canary (customers tagged). cohort 2 deployed 5m ago. devex_lead: proposed path: 1) pause promotion of cohort 2 -> 30m hold; 2) unpublish the npm canary dist-tag for canary-2 if bad; 3) republish corrected npm package as canary-2-fixed; 4) pin installs for affected customers to previous stable if rollback needed. support_liz: we already received a Slack ping from an external partner on cohort 2 complaining about `createClient` missing. they're blocking QA. rick_sdk: quick rollback commands: ``` # remove bad tag npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk next-canary-2 # reassign next to stable npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.3.1 latest ``` For python, republishing wheels with same version isn't ideal. we should publish a patch 1.3.2 with fix. maya.dev: can we avoid unpublishing? npm unpublish is destructive. better to remove the dist-tag and publish a new canary tag `next-canary-2-fix` and update routing so cohort 2 resolves to that tag. devex_lead: agreed, do not unpublish. Policy: only yank artifacts on CVE/security. For functional regressions, remove dist-tag and re-publish fixed artifact. Ops Sam, prepare routing pin for cohort 2 to fallback version 1.3.1 while we push fix. ops_sam: creating routing pin now: `infra-routing pin redwood-sdk cohort=2 version=1.3.1 reason="ts-bundle-missing-export"` deploy-bot: routing pin created and visible in release tasks. to remove: `/routing unpin redwood-sdk cohort=2` rick_sdk: I'll cut a 1.3.2 patch for py/ts with the build fix and a short changelog. publishing in ~8m. maya.dev: add smoke step that verifies import patterns across CJS/ESM/TS: `node -r esm test/import-check.js` and `python -c "import redwood_sdk; from redwood_sdk import create_client"` devex_lead: include deprecation note in release text reminding users of legacy sync client deprecation (planned in next major). Keep wording soft: "This release fixes a packaging regression affecting named exports in canary builds. No API changes. Legacy sync client deprecation reminder." support_liz: I'll draft customer notification: short, explicit, include mitigation and ETA for fix. Link to docs for pinning installs. deploy-bot: publish job queued: `ci/publish/redwood-sdk/1.3.2` will post status. deploy-bot: publish job: FAILED -> bundle step error in rollup. logs: https://logs.internal/release/1751234567/publish. Error: unexpected token in build config. rick_sdk: investigate: forgot to include `namedExports: true` shim in rollup-plugin-commonjs. pushing quick pr to fix build config. maya.dev: re-run publish after build fixed. if publish succeeds, we should run a targeted smoke on cohort 2 (20 installs) before unpinning. deploy-bot: publish job: SUCCEEDED -> npm @redwood/sdk@1.3.2-next-canary-2-fixed published, py 1.3.2rc wheel uploaded to test PyPI. ops_sam: smoke-run queued: `ci/smoke-cohort-2-imports` -> 20 samples. deploy-bot: smoke-run: 0/20 failures. devex_lead: OK to remove routing pin and promote canary-2-fixed to normal canary channel. Ben, please update release notes and mark the canary cohort as resumed. Also add follow-up task to add import compatibility test to CI and a checklist item in release playbook to avoid build-config changes landing during publish windows. support_liz: customer notifications sent. included instructions to pin to 1.3.1 if they need immediate rollback and note that fixed release is available. rick_sdk: added changelog entry: "1.3.2 - fix: packaging/regression - restore named exports for TS bundle; py: patch wheel to match." maya.dev: filing a small postmortem doc: `/docs/releases/pm-1751234567-bundle-regression.md` with timeline and root cause. devex_lead: good work. reminder: keep publish bot logs and dist-tag history archived for audits. We'll close the incident after the postmortem and the CI gating test added. :white_check_mark:
